notes: Three Web UI fixes. The bulk NAT dialog refused 90001 with "Port NAT phải lớn hơn 20000" -- a message naming a rule that value already satisfies. The check was right (20001-65535, the same range validateNATPort enforces) but the wording gave only the lower bound, so a number above 65535 was rejected for a reason that made no sense. The message now states the whole range in both locales, across all five places that guard it, and the dialog no longer auto-fills 65536 when a router already uses the last legal port. The public IP of a client's PPPoE session moved out from under the Internet cell and into the rotate button's tooltip: that line cost every client row a second line of height for something read rarely, and hovering the button now shows "IP hiện tại" above the reason the button is enabled or disabled, updating in place after a rotate. And "Copy ip:port" can now copy a DDNS hostname instead of the public IP, which changes on every rotate -- it asks which to use, but only when a DNS name actually exists behind one of the selected ports, and a dismissed dialog copies nothing rather than silently picking one.
